NameError.title: Python doesn't know "{name}"
NameError.explanation: You are using the name {name}, but it has not been created yet at this point.
NameError.tip: Check the spelling (capital letters count) and make sure you wrote {name} = ... before using it. To show text, put it between quotes.

UnboundLocalError.title: The variable "{name}" is used too early
UnboundLocalError.explanation: Python found {name} in a function before it was given a value.
UnboundLocalError.tip: Give {name} a value before reading it.

SyntaxError.title: Python doesn't understand this line
SyntaxError.explanation: The sentence is badly written: a symbol is missing or there is one too many.
SyntaxError.tip: Reread the line shown, and the one before it too: quotes, parentheses and colons are the usual causes.

SyntaxError.unterminated_string.title: A text is not closed
SyntaxError.unterminated_string.explanation: You opened a quote but never closed it.
SyntaxError.unterminated_string.tip: Add the missing quote at the end of the text.

SyntaxError.never_closed.title: A closing "{char}" is missing
SyntaxError.never_closed.explanation: You opened a "{char}" that is never closed.
SyntaxError.never_closed.tip: Count the opening and closing symbols: there must be as many of each.

SyntaxError.unmatched.title: An extra "{char}"
SyntaxError.unmatched.explanation: You close a "{char}" that was never opened.
SyntaxError.unmatched.tip: Remove it, or add the matching opening symbol.

SyntaxError.expected_colon.title: A colon ":" is missing
SyntaxError.expected_colon.explanation: This line must end with ":" to announce the block that follows.
SyntaxError.expected_colon.tip: Add ":" at the end of the line.

SyntaxError.print_parens.title: print() is written with parentheses
SyntaxError.print_parens.explanation: In Python 3, the text to show goes between parentheses.

SyntaxError.forgot_comma.title: A comma may be missing
SyntaxError.forgot_comma.explanation: Two items follow each other without a separator.
SyntaxError.forgot_comma.tip: Add a comma between the items of a list or a call.

SyntaxError.invalid_number.title: This number is badly written
SyntaxError.invalid_number.explanation: A number cannot be directly followed by letters.
SyntaxError.invalid_number.tip: To multiply, write 2 * x. For text, use quotes.

IndentationError.title: The indentation of this line is wrong
IndentationError.explanation: In Python, the spaces at the start of a line matter: they show which block it belongs to.
IndentationError.tip: Align this line with the others of the same block, using 4 spaces.

IndentationError.expected_block.title: An indented block is missing
IndentationError.expected_block.explanation: After a line ending with ":", the next line must be shifted by 4 spaces.
IndentationError.expected_block.tip: Add 4 spaces at the start of the following line.

TypeError.title: These values don't go together
TypeError.explanation: You are trying an operation on types that are not compatible.
TypeError.tip: Check each value's type with type(), and convert if needed with int(), float() or str().

TypeError.operand.title: Cannot do "{op}" between {left} and {right}
TypeError.operand.explanation: A {left} and a {right} cannot be combined with "{op}".
TypeError.operand.tip: Convert one of the values: int() or float() for a number, str() for text.

TypeError.concat.title: You cannot glue text and a {other} together
TypeError.concat.explanation: "+" glues texts together, but one of the values here is a {other}.
TypeError.concat.tip: Turn it into text with str(), or separate the values with commas in print().

TypeError.not_callable.title: A {type} is not called like a function
TypeError.not_callable.explanation: Parentheses right after a name mean "call a function", but this name holds a {type}.
TypeError.not_callable.tip: Remove the parentheses, or check that you did not reuse a function's name for a variable.

TypeError.arg_count.title: {fn}() did not get the right number of values
TypeError.arg_count.tip: Count the values between the parentheses of the call.

TypeError.missing_arg.title: {fn}() got too few values
TypeError.missing_arg.explanation: {count} required value(s) are missing in the call to {fn}().
TypeError.missing_arg.tip: Compare the call with the function's definition: each parameter expects a value.

ValueError.title: This value is not acceptable here
ValueError.explanation: The type is right, but the content does not suit this operation.
ValueError.tip: Check what the value contains with print().

ValueError.invalid_int.title: {value} is not a whole number
ValueError.invalid_int.explanation: int() can only convert text that looks like a whole number, such as "42".
ValueError.invalid_int.tip: Check there are no letters, comma or spaces in the text.

ValueError.invalid_float.title: {value} is not a number
ValueError.invalid_float.explanation: float() can only convert text such as "3.14".
ValueError.invalid_float.tip: Use a dot, not a comma, for decimals.

ZeroDivisionError.title: You cannot divide by zero
ZeroDivisionError.explanation: A division whose divisor is 0 has no result.
ZeroDivisionError.tip: Check the value you divide by.

IndexError.title: This position does not exist in the list
IndexError.explanation: You ask for an item beyond the end of the list. Positions start at 0.
IndexError.tip: A list of 3 items has positions 0, 1 and 2. Check with len().

KeyError.title: The key {key} does not exist
KeyError.explanation: The dictionary does not contain this key.
KeyError.tip: Check the key's spelling, or test it with "in" before reading it.

AttributeError.title: A {type} has no "{attr}"
AttributeError.explanation: You ask a {type} for something it cannot do or does not have.
AttributeError.tip: Check the spelling of {attr}, and the type of the value.

ModuleNotFoundError.title: The module "{module}" cannot be found
ModuleNotFoundError.explanation: Python finds no module with this name.
ModuleNotFoundError.tip: Check the spelling of the import. Some modules are not available in the browser.

KeyboardInterrupt.title: Execution stopped
KeyboardInterrupt.explanation: The program was interrupted before it finished.
KeyboardInterrupt.tip: If it was an endless loop, check that its condition becomes false at some point.

EOFError.title: The program is waiting for input
EOFError.explanation: input() asks the user for a value, which is not possible in this cell.
EOFError.tip: Replace input() with a value written directly in the code.

RecursionError.title: A function calls itself endlessly
RecursionError.explanation: Python stopped the program because the function calls itself too many times.
RecursionError.tip: Add a stopping condition to the function.

Unknown.title: An error occurred: {type}
Unknown.tip: Reread the line shown and compare it with the level's examples.
